source.text: וְיָצָ֥א חֹ֖טֶר מִגֵּ֣זַע יִשָׁ֑י וְנֵ֖צֶר מִשָּׁרָשָׁ֥יו יִפְרֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And will go forth [a] shoot from [the] stump of Jesse, and [a] branch from his roots will bear fruit.

en.L: And a shoot will go forth from the stump of Jesse, \q and a branch from his roots will bear fruit.
en.B: A shoot will grow from Jesse's stump, \q and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit.
en.R: The family of Jesse, King David's father, will be like a tree cut down to a stump. But a new shoot will grow from that stump. \q A branch will grow from its roots and bear fruit.

es.L: Y saldrá un brote del tocón de Isaí, \q y un retoño de sus raíces dará fruto.
es.B: Del tocón de Isaí crecerá un brote, \q y un retoño de sus raíces dará fruto.
es.R: La familia de Isaí, el padre del rey David, será como un árbol cortado hasta el tocón. Pero de ese tocón crecerá un brote nuevo. \q De sus raíces crecerá un retoño que dará fruto.

fr.L: Et un rameau sortira de la souche de Jessé, \q et un rejeton de ses racines portera du fruit.
fr.B: Un rameau poussera de la souche de Jessé, \q et un rejeton issu de ses racines portera du fruit.
fr.R: La famille de Jessé, le père du roi David, sera comme un arbre coupé dont il ne reste que la souche. Mais une nouvelle pousse sortira de cette souche. \q Un rejeton poussera de ses racines et portera du fruit.

sw.L: Na chipukizi litatoka katika kisiki cha Yese, \q na tawi kutoka katika mizizi yake litazaa matunda.
sw.B: Chipukizi litaota kutoka kisiki cha Yese, \q na tawi litakalotoka katika mizizi yake litazaa matunda.
sw.R: Jamaa ya Yese, baba yake mfalme Daudi, itakuwa kama mti uliokatwa ukabaki kisiki. Lakini chipukizi jipya litaota kutoka kisiki hicho. \q Tawi litaota kutoka katika mizizi yake na kuzaa matunda.

decisions.choice: the stump of Jesse: the royal family of David, cut down like a felled tree
decisions.reason: Jesse was David's father (1 Samuel 16:1-13), so his stump is David's royal line. Just before this, in 10:33-34, the LORD cuts down the proud forest of Assyria; here a tree that has also been cut down sends up new life. The family will be brought low, but a king will still come from it.

decisions.choice: shoot ... branch: a fresh young growth from an old root
decisions.reason: The first word is used elsewhere only of a rod or stick (Proverbs 14:3); the second is a green shoot or sprout (14:19; 60:21). Both picture new, small growth. Jeremiah 23:5 and Zechariah 3:8 use a different word, "Branch", for the same promised king.

decisions.choice: will bear fruit (the Hebrew text)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "will bear fruit". The Septuagint has "will come up", which may reflect a Hebrew verb "will sprout" spelled with almost the same letters. The Hebrew reading is kept; both say that the shoot will flourish.

decisions.choice: The family of Jesse, King David's father, will be like a tree cut down
decisions.reason: Readable says who Jesse was and spells out the picture of the stump (m1).

decisions.choice: un brote ... un retoño (lowercase)
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets it, the shoot is "un brote" and the branch "un retoño", lowercase, since they picture new growth from a felled tree. The king of this chapter takes no deity_pronoun span. "Isaí" is the published Spanish form of Jesse.

decisions.choice: "chipukizi" and "tawi", lowercase
decisions.reason: The terms note settles "chipukizi" and "tawi" here; they picture new growth from David's line (m2), and the king takes no deity span, as in English.

decisions.choice: "un rameau ... de la souche de Jessé, un rejeton"
decisions.reason: The terms note’s wording; no deity_pronoun span on the coming king, as in English.

source.text: וְנָחָ֥ה עָלָ֖יו ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֑ה ר֧וּחַ חָכְמָ֣ה וּבִינָ֗ה ר֤וּחַ עֵצָה֙ וּגְבוּרָ֔ה ר֥וּחַ דַּ֖עַת וְיִרְאַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And will rest on him [the] Spirit of Yahweh, [a] spirit of wisdom and understanding, [a] spirit of counsel and might, [a] spirit of knowledge and [the] fear of Yahweh.

en.L: And the Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will rest upon him, \q [the] Spirit of wisdom and understanding, [the] Spirit of counsel and might, \q [the] Spirit of knowledge and of the fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: The Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will settle on him: \q the Spirit who gives wisdom and insight, the Spirit of counsel and power, \q the Spirit of knowledge and of the fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will stay on him. \q The Spirit will make him wise and give him understanding. The Spirit will help him make good plans and will give him power. \q The Spirit will help him know {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and have deep respect for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y reposará sobre él el Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q Espíritu de sabiduría y de entendimiento, Espíritu de consejo y de poder, \q Espíritu de conocimiento y de temor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: El Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se posará sobre él: \q el Espíritu que da sabiduría e inteligencia, el Espíritu de consejo y de poder, \q el Espíritu de conocimiento y de temor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: El Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} permanecerá sobre él. \q El Espíritu lo hará sabio y le dará entendimiento. El Espíritu lo ayudará a hacer buenos planes y le dará poder. \q El Espíritu lo ayudará a conocer {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y a tenerle un profundo respeto {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et l’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} reposera sur lui, \q Esprit de sagesse et d’intelligence, Esprit de conseil et de force, \q Esprit de connaissance et de crainte {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: L’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} se posera sur lui : \q l’Esprit qui donne la sagesse et l’intelligence, l’Esprit de conseil et de puissance, \q l’Esprit de connaissance et de crainte {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: L’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} restera sur lui. \q L’Esprit le rendra sage et lui donnera l’intelligence. L’Esprit l’aidera à faire de bons projets et lui donnera de la force. \q L’Esprit l’aidera à connaître {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et à avoir un profond respect pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakaa juu yake, \q Roho wa hekima na ufahamu, Roho wa shauri na uweza, \q Roho wa maarifa na wa kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atatulia juu yake: \q Roho anayetoa hekima na ufahamu, Roho wa shauri na nguvu, \q Roho wa maarifa na wa kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakaa juu yake. \q Roho atampa hekima na ufahamu. Roho atamsaidia kupanga mipango mizuri na atampa nguvu. \q Roho atamsaidia kumjua {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kumheshimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa hofu takatifu.

decisions.choice: the Spirit of Yahweh will rest on him: God's Spirit equipping him to lead
decisions.reason: The same verb "rest" is used when the spirit rested on the seventy elders (Numbers 11:25-26), and the Spirit of the LORD came on David when he was anointed (1 Samuel 16:13). Isaiah 61:1 speaks again of the Spirit of the Lord upon one whom the LORD anoints.

decisions.choice: a spirit of wisdom ... counsel ... knowledge: the one Spirit of Yahweh, described by what it gives
alternatives: knowledge in general, and the fear of Yahweh
decisions.reason: The three pairs that follow are not other spirits. They describe the Spirit of Yahweh by the gifts it brings: wisdom and understanding to see rightly, counsel and might to plan and to carry it out, knowledge and the fear of Yahweh. "Yahweh" at the end may govern both words of the last pair, so that it means knowing Yahweh and revering him (compare verse 9).

decisions.choice: the fear of Yahweh (the Hebrew text)
decisions.reason: The Septuagint renders this "fear" as "godliness" and then adds "the spirit of the fear of God" from verse 3, so that it lists seven gifts. The traditional list of the seven gifts of the Spirit comes from that Greek wording. The Hebrew lists six, in three pairs.

decisions.choice: the Spirit who gives wisdom
decisions.reason: Balanced supplies "who gives" once to show how the pairs relate to the Spirit (m2), and writes "Spirit" with a capital throughout, since it is the one Spirit of the LORD.

decisions.choice: help him make good plans; deep respect for the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable explains "counsel" as making good plans and "fear" as deep respect, the awe that leads to obedience, not terror.

decisions.choice: temor del SEÑOR (L, B); profundo respeto (R)
decisions.reason: The fear of the LORD is "el temor del SEÑOR" at L and B and is explained at R as reverent respect, as the Psalms note sets it ("honrar al SEÑOR con reverencia").

decisions.choice: "Roho wa BWANA" with personal agreement through the verse
decisions.reason: The one Spirit of the LORD is described by what he gives (m2), so each "Roho" is capitalized and takes the personal "wa", as the English capital S. "Kumcha BWANA" (L, B) and "kumheshimu BWANA kwa hofu takatifu" (R) follow the Psalms note.

source.text: וַהֲרִיח֖וֹ בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־לְמַרְאֵ֤ה עֵינָיו֙ יִשְׁפּ֔וֹט וְלֹֽא־לְמִשְׁמַ֥ע אָזְנָ֖יו יוֹכִֽיחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And his delight [will be] in [the] fear of Yahweh, and not by [the] sight of his eyes will he judge, and not by [the] hearing of his ears will he decide.

en.L: And his delight [will be] in the fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and not by the sight of his eyes will he judge, \q and not by the hearing of his ears will he decide.
en.B: Fearing {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be his delight. \q He will not judge by what his eyes take in, \q or give rulings by what reaches his ears.
en.R: He will find joy in respecting {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q He will not judge people by how things look. \q He will not decide what is right just by what he hears others say.

es.L: Y su deleite [estará] en el temor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q y no juzgará por lo que vean sus ojos, \q ni decidirá por lo que oigan sus oídos.
es.B: Temer {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} será su deleite. \q No juzgará por lo que vean sus ojos \q ni dictará sentencia por lo que lleguen a oír sus oídos.
es.R: Hallará alegría en respetar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. \q No juzgará a la gente por las apariencias. \q No decidirá lo que es justo solo por lo que oiga decir a otros.

fr.L: Et son plaisir [sera] dans la crainte {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q et il ne jugera pas sur ce que voient ses yeux, \q et il ne décidera pas sur ce qu’entendent ses oreilles.
fr.B: Craindre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fera sa joie. \q Il ne jugera pas d’après ce que voient ses yeux, \q ni ne tranchera d’après ce qui parvient à ses oreilles.
fr.R: Il trouvera sa joie dans le respect {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. \q Il ne jugera pas les gens d’après les apparences. \q Il ne décidera pas de ce qui est juste seulement d’après ce que les autres disent.

sw.L: Na furaha yake [itakuwa] katika kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q wala hatahukumu kwa kuona kwa macho yake, \q wala hataamua kwa kusikia kwa masikio yake.
sw.B: Kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kutakuwa furaha yake. \q Hatahukumu kwa yale ambayo macho yake yanayaona, \q wala kutoa maamuzi kwa yale yanayofika masikioni mwake.
sw.R: Atapata furaha katika kumheshimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Hatawahukumu watu kwa jinsi mambo yanavyoonekana. \q Hataamua lililo sawa kwa kusikia tu yale ambayo wengine wanasema.

decisions.choice: his delight: what he enjoys, literally "his smelling"
decisions.reason: The verb comes from the word for scent and is used of God enjoying the smell of an offering (Genesis 8:21; Amos 5:21). Here it means taking pleasure in something: the king will enjoy revering Yahweh.

decisions.choice: decide: give a ruling, settle a dispute
decisions.reason: The verb is used of judging between parties, as in 2:4 ("he will decide for many peoples") and in verse 4. The king's rulings will not rest on appearances or on what others report (compare 1 Samuel 16:7).

decisions.choice: respecting the LORD
decisions.reason: As in verse 2, Readable explains "the fear of the LORD" as respect for him.

source.text: וְשָׁפַ֤ט בְּצֶ֨דֶק֙ דַּלִּ֔ים וְהוֹכִ֥יחַ בְּמִישׁ֖וֹר לְעַנְוֵי־אָ֑רֶץ וְהִֽכָּה־אֶ֨רֶץ֙ בְּשֵׁ֣בֶט פִּ֔יו וּבְר֥וּחַ שְׂפָתָ֖יו יָמִ֥ית רָשָֽׁע׃

records.literal_gloss: And he will judge with righteousness [the] poor, and decide with uprightness for [the] humble of [the] earth, and he will strike [the] earth with [the] rod of his mouth, and with [the] breath of his lips he will put to death [the] wicked.

en.L: And with righteousness he will judge the poor, \q and decide with uprightness for the humble of the earth; \q and he will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth, \q and with the breath of his lips he will put the wicked to death.
en.B: He will do right by the poor when he judges, \q and give fair rulings for the lowly of the land. \q With his word as a rod he will strike the earth; \q the breath from his lips will bring death to the wicked.
en.R: He will judge poor people fairly. \q He will make right decisions for people who are humble and weak. \q When he speaks, his words will punish the earth like a rod. \q With just a breath from his mouth he will put evil people to death.

es.L: Y con justicia juzgará a los pobres, \q y decidirá con equidad a favor de los humildes de la tierra; \q y herirá la tierra con la vara de su boca, \q y con el aliento de sus labios dará muerte al malvado.
es.B: Hará justicia a los pobres cuando juzgue \q y dará fallos justos a favor de los humildes del país. \q Con su palabra como vara golpeará la tierra; \q el aliento de sus labios dará muerte a los malvados.
es.R: Juzgará con justicia a los pobres. \q Tomará decisiones correctas a favor de los humildes y débiles. \q Cuando hable, sus palabras castigarán la tierra como una vara. \q Con solo un soplo de su boca dará muerte a los malvados.

fr.L: Et il jugera les pauvres avec justice, \q et décidera avec droiture pour les humbles de la terre ; \q et il frappera la terre avec la verge de sa bouche, \q et par le souffle de ses lèvres il fera mourir le méchant.
fr.B: Il fera justice aux pauvres quand il jugera, \q et rendra des décisions équitables pour les humbles du pays. \q Sa parole sera la verge dont il frappera la terre ; \q le souffle de ses lèvres fera mourir le méchant.
fr.R: Il jugera les pauvres avec justice. \q Il prendra de bonnes décisions pour les gens humbles et faibles. \q Quand il parlera, ses paroles puniront la terre comme un bâton. \q D’un seul souffle de sa bouche, il fera mourir les méchants.

sw.L: Bali kwa haki atawahukumu maskini, \q na kuamua kwa unyofu kwa ajili ya wanyenyekevu wa dunia; \q naye ataipiga dunia kwa fimbo ya kinywa chake, \q na kwa pumzi ya midomo yake atamwua mwovu.
sw.B: Atawatendea maskini haki anapohukumu, \q na kutoa maamuzi ya haki kwa wanyonge wa nchi. \q Kwa neno lake kama fimbo ataipiga dunia; \q pumzi ya midomo yake itawaletea waovu kifo.
sw.R: Atawahukumu maskini kwa haki. \q Atafanya maamuzi yaliyo sawa kwa ajili ya watu wanyenyekevu na dhaifu. \q Anaposema, maneno yake yataiadhibu dunia kama fimbo. \q Kwa pumzi tu ya kinywa chake atawaua watu waovu.

decisions.choice: righteousness ... uprightness: judging fairly and as God requires
decisions.reason: In a court "righteousness" is a judgment that is right and fair, and "uprightness" is level, even-handed dealing. Kings were to defend the poor (Psalm 72:1-4, 12-14), as Judah's rulers had failed to do (1:23; 10:1-2).

decisions.choice: the rod of his mouth ... the breath of his lips: his spoken word as his weapon
decisions.reason: He strikes with what he says, not with an army. Isaiah 49:2 describes a mouth made like a sharp sword. Paul echoes this line when he says the Lord Jesus will destroy the lawless one with the breath of his mouth (2 Thessalonians 2:8; compare Revelation 19:15).

decisions.choice: the earth: the earth and its people, of whom the wicked are struck
decisions.reason: The same word means "land" or "earth". "The humble of the land" are the poor in his own country; the earth that he strikes is the whole world under judgment, where the parallel line names the wicked as those put to death.

decisions.choice: When he speaks, his words will punish the earth like a rod
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of the rod of his mouth (m2).

source.text: וְהָ֥יָה צֶ֖דֶק אֵז֣וֹר מָתְנָ֑יו וְהָאֱמוּנָ֖ה אֵז֥וֹר חֲלָצָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be righteousness [the] belt of his waist, and faithfulness [the] belt of his loins.

en.L: And righteousness will be the belt of his waist, \q and faithfulness the belt of his loins.
en.B: Righteousness will be the belt around his waist, \q and faithfulness the sash bound at his hips.
en.R: Righteousness and faithfulness will always be part of him, like a belt he wears around his waist.

es.L: Y la justicia será el cinturón de su cintura, \q y la fidelidad el cinturón de sus caderas.
es.B: La justicia será el cinturón que rodee su cintura, \q y la fidelidad la faja ceñida a sus caderas.
es.R: La justicia y la fidelidad siempre serán parte de él, como un cinturón que lleva puesto alrededor de la cintura.

fr.L: Et la justice sera la ceinture de ses reins, \q et la fidélité la ceinture de ses hanches.
fr.B: La justice sera la ceinture qui serre sa taille, \q et la fidélité l’écharpe nouée à ses hanches.
fr.R: La justice et la fidélité feront toujours partie de lui, comme une ceinture qu’il porte autour de la taille.

sw.L: Na haki itakuwa mshipi wa kiuno chake, \q na uaminifu mshipi wa viuno vyake.
sw.B: Haki itakuwa mshipi kiunoni mwake, \q na uaminifu mkanda uliofungwa viunoni mwake.
sw.R: Haki na uaminifu vitakuwa sehemu yake daima, kama mshipi anaoufunga kiunoni.

decisions.choice: belt: the band tied around the waist, ready for work or battle
decisions.reason: The word is a waistband or loincloth (5:27; Jeremiah 13:1). Tying it on meant being ready for action (1 Kings 18:46). The king is ready for his work, and what holds him together is righteousness and faithfulness. Ephesians 6:14 uses a similar picture.

decisions.choice: faithfulness: reliability, keeping one's word
decisions.reason: The word is from the root "be firm". It is the quality of someone who can be relied on (compare 7:9, where the same root means to stand firm by trusting).

decisions.choice: one belt for both lines
decisions.reason: Readable joins the two parallel lines into one sentence and says what the picture means: these qualities will always be part of him.

source.text: וְגָ֤ר זְאֵב֙ עִם־כֶּ֔בֶשׂ וְנָמֵ֖ר עִם־גְּדִ֣י יִרְבָּ֑ץ וְעֵ֨גֶל וּכְפִ֤יר וּמְרִיא֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו וְנַ֥עַר קָטֹ֖ן נֹהֵ֥ג בָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And will dwell [the] wolf with [the] lamb, and [the] leopard with [the] young goat will lie down, and [the] calf and [the] young lion and [the] fattened [animal] together, and [a] little boy [will be] leading them.

en.L: And the wolf will dwell as a guest with the lamb, \q and the leopard with the young goat will lie down, \q and the calf and the young lion and the fattened [animal] together, \q and a little boy [will be] leading them.
en.B: The wolf will stay as a guest with the lamb, \q and the leopard will lie down beside the young goat; \q calf and young lion and fatted steer will be together, \q and a small boy will drive them along.
en.R: Wolves will live peacefully with lambs. \q Leopards will lie down with young goats. \q Calves, young lions, and fat cattle will stay together, \q and a little boy will lead them.

es.L: Y el lobo habitará como huésped con el cordero, \q y el leopardo con el cabrito se acostará, \q y el becerro y el leoncillo y el animal engordado juntos, \q y un niño pequeño los guiará.
es.B: El lobo se hospedará con el cordero, \q y el leopardo se echará junto al cabrito; \q el becerro, el león joven y el novillo cebado estarán juntos, \q y un niño pequeño los conducirá.
es.R: Los lobos vivirán en paz con los corderos. \q Los leopardos se echarán con los cabritos. \q Los becerros, los leones jóvenes y el ganado gordo estarán juntos, \q y un niño pequeño los guiará.

fr.L: Et le loup séjournera avec l’agneau, \q et le léopard avec le chevreau se couchera, \q et le veau et le lionceau et la bête grasse ensemble, \q et un petit garçon les conduira.
fr.B: Le loup sera l’hôte de l’agneau, \q et le léopard se couchera près du chevreau ; \q le veau, le lionceau et le bœuf gras seront ensemble, \q et un petit garçon les mènera.
fr.R: Les loups vivront en paix avec les agneaux. \q Les léopards se coucheront avec les chevreaux. \q Les veaux, les jeunes lions et les bœufs gras resteront ensemble, \q et un petit garçon les conduira.

sw.L: Na mbwa mwitu atakaa kama mgeni pamoja na mwana-kondoo, \q na chui atalala pamoja na mwana-mbuzi, \q na ndama na mwana-simba na [mnyama] aliyenona pamoja, \q na mvulana mdogo [atakuwa] akiwaongoza.
sw.B: Mbwa mwitu atakaa kama mgeni kwa mwana-kondoo, \q na chui atalala karibu na mwana-mbuzi; \q ndama na mwana-simba na ng'ombe aliyenona watakuwa pamoja, \q na mvulana mdogo atawachunga.
sw.R: Mbwa mwitu wataishi kwa amani pamoja na wana-kondoo. \q Chui watalala pamoja na wana-mbuzi. \q Ndama, wana-simba na ng'ombe walionona watakaa pamoja, \q na mvulana mdogo atawaongoza.

decisions.choice: dwell as a guest: live as a welcome stranger
decisions.reason: The verb is used of a foreigner who lives among a people under their protection (Genesis 12:10; Exodus 12:48). The wolf will be the lamb's guest instead of its hunter.

decisions.choice: a picture of peace in creation under the coming king
decisions.reason: Animals that prey on each other live together, and a child is safe among them. Isaiah 65:25 repeats the picture for the new heavens and new earth, and Hosea 2:20 speaks of a covenant with the animals. The text does not say whether the picture is to be taken of animals alone or also of peoples; the translation keeps the picture as it stands.

decisions.choice: the fattened animal (the Hebrew text)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "fatling", a calf fattened for a feast. The Septuagint has "will graze together" here, which reflects a Hebrew verb spelled with nearly the same letters. The Hebrew reading is kept.

decisions.choice: live peacefully with
decisions.reason: Readable says the animals live together in peace, which is the point of the wolf being the lamb's guest (m1), and uses plurals for the kinds of animals.

source.text: וּפָרָ֤ה וָדֹב֙ תִּרְעֶ֔ינָה יַחְדָּ֖ו יִרְבְּצ֣וּ יַלְדֵיהֶ֑ן וְאַרְיֵ֖ה כַּבָּקָ֥ר יֹֽאכַל־תֶּֽבֶן׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] cow and [the] bear will graze; together will lie down their young; and [the] lion like [the] ox will eat straw.

en.L: And the cow and the bear will graze; \q their young will lie down together; \q and the lion like the ox will eat straw.
en.B: Cow and bear will feed side by side, \q their young will rest together, \q and the lion will eat straw as the ox does.
en.R: Cows and bears will eat grass side by side. \q Their babies will lie down together. \q Lions will eat straw just as oxen do.

es.L: Y la vaca y la osa pacerán; \q sus crías se echarán juntas; \q y el león como el buey comerá paja.
es.B: La vaca y la osa pastarán una junto a la otra, \q sus crías descansarán juntas, \q y el león comerá paja como el buey.
es.R: Las vacas y los osos comerán pasto uno al lado del otro. \q Sus crías se echarán juntas. \q Los leones comerán paja como los bueyes.

fr.L: Et la vache et l’ourse paîtront ; \q leurs petits se coucheront ensemble ; \q et le lion comme le bœuf mangera de la paille.
fr.B: La vache et l’ourse brouteront côte à côte, \q leurs petits se reposeront ensemble, \q et le lion mangera de la paille comme le bœuf.
fr.R: Les vaches et les ours mangeront de l’herbe côte à côte. \q Leurs petits se coucheront ensemble. \q Les lions mangeront de la paille comme les bœufs.

sw.L: Na ng'ombe na dubu watalisha; \q watoto wao watalala pamoja; \q na simba kama ng'ombe atakula majani makavu.
sw.B: Ng'ombe na dubu watalisha bega kwa bega, \q watoto wao watapumzika pamoja, \q na simba atakula majani makavu kama ng'ombe.
sw.R: Ng'ombe na dubu watakula majani pamoja. \q Watoto wao watalala pamoja. \q Simba watakula majani makavu kama ng'ombe.

decisions.choice: the cow and the bear will graze: the bear feeds on plants alongside the cow
decisions.reason: The verb "graze" has both animals as subject: the bear will feed as the cow does. In the same way the lion will eat straw. None of them will kill to eat.

decisions.choice: the lion will eat straw: food from plants, as at the beginning
decisions.reason: In Genesis 1:30 God gives the animals green plants for food. Isaiah 65:25 repeats this line about the lion.

source.text: וְשִֽׁעֲשַׁ֥ע יוֹנֵ֖ק עַל־חֻ֣ר פָּ֑תֶן וְעַל֙ מְאוּרַ֣ת צִפְעוֹנִ֔י גָּמ֖וּל יָד֥וֹ הָדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And will play [a] nursing child over [the] hole of [a] cobra, and over [the] den of [a] viper [a] weaned [child] his hand will put.

en.L: And a nursing child will play over the hole of a cobra, \q and over the den of a viper a weaned [child] will put his hand.
en.B: A baby still at the breast will play by the cobra's hole, \q and a child just weaned will reach into the viper's den.
en.R: A baby will play safely near a cobra's hole. \q A small child will put his hand into a poisonous snake's nest and not be hurt.

es.L: Y el niño de pecho jugará sobre la cueva de la cobra, \q y sobre la guarida de la víbora el niño destetado pondrá su mano.
es.B: El bebé que aún mama jugará junto al agujero de la cobra, \q y el niño recién destetado meterá la mano en la guarida de la víbora.
es.R: Un bebé jugará tranquilo cerca del agujero de una cobra. \q Un niño pequeño meterá la mano en el nido de una serpiente venenosa y no le pasará nada.

fr.L: Et le nourrisson jouera sur le trou du cobra, \q et sur le repaire de la vipère l’enfant sevré mettra sa main.
fr.B: Le bébé encore au sein jouera près du trou du cobra, \q et l’enfant à peine sevré mettra la main dans le repaire de la vipère.
fr.R: Un bébé jouera sans danger près du trou d’un cobra. \q Un petit enfant mettra la main dans le nid d’un serpent venimeux et il ne lui arrivera rien.

sw.L: Na mtoto anyonyaye atacheza juu ya tundu la nyoka, \q na juu ya pango la fira mtoto aliyeachishwa [ziwa] atatia mkono wake.
sw.B: Mtoto ambaye bado ananyonya atacheza karibu na tundu la nyoka mwenye sumu, \q na mtoto aliyeachishwa ziwa atatia mkono katika pango la fira.
sw.R: Mtoto mchanga atacheza salama karibu na tundu la nyoka. \q Mtoto mdogo atatia mkono wake katika shimo la nyoka mwenye sumu wala hataumia.

decisions.choice: cobra ... viper: deadly snakes
decisions.reason: The first snake is named with the cobra in Psalm 58:5 and 91:13; the second is a venomous snake (14:29; 59:5; Jeremiah 8:17). Their exact species are not certain, but both are poisonous.

decisions.choice: den: a hole or opening where the snake lives
decisions.reason: This word appears only here. It is related to the word for "light" and may mean an opening that lets in light, a hole in the ground. The parallel with "hole" shows the sense.

decisions.choice: a child safe beside the snake
decisions.reason: Since Genesis 3:15 there has been hostility between the snake and humankind. In the king's reign even small children will be safe from snakes.

decisions.choice: safely ... and not be hurt
decisions.reason: Readable says outright what the picture implies: the children will come to no harm.

source.text: לֹֽא־יָרֵ֥עוּ וְלֹֽא־יַשְׁחִ֖יתוּ בְּכָל־הַ֣ר קָדְשִׁ֑י כִּֽי־מָלְאָ֣ה הָאָ֗רֶץ דֵּעָה֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֔ה כַּמַּ֖יִם לַיָּ֥ם מְכַסִּֽים׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Not they will harm and not they will destroy in all [the] mountain of my holiness, for will be full the earth [of] knowledge of Yahweh as the waters [are] covering the sea.

en.L: They will not do harm and they will not destroy in all the mountain of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holiness, \q for the earth will be full of the knowledge of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} \q as the waters cover the sea.
en.B: None will hurt and none will destroy anywhere on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy mountain, \q for the earth will be as full of knowing {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} \q as the sea is full of water.
en.R: There will be no harm and no destruction anywhere on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy mountain. \q Everyone on earth will know {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q The earth will be full of this knowledge, just as the oceans are full of water.

es.L: No harán daño ni destruirán en todo el monte de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santidad, \q porque la tierra estará llena del conocimiento {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} \q como las aguas cubren el mar.
es.B: Nadie hará daño y nadie destruirá en todo {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} monte santo, \q porque la tierra estará tan llena del conocimiento {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} \q como el mar está lleno de agua.
es.R: No habrá daño ni destrucción en ninguna parte de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} monte santo. \q Todos en la tierra conocerán {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. \q La tierra estará llena de este conocimiento, así como los océanos están llenos de agua.

fr.L: On ne fera pas de mal et on ne détruira pas sur toute la montagne de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} sainteté, \q car la terre sera remplie de la connaissance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} \q comme les eaux couvrent la mer.
fr.B: Personne ne fera de mal, personne ne détruira, sur toute {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} montagne sainte, \q car la terre sera aussi pleine de la connaissance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} \q que la mer est pleine d’eau.
fr.R: Il n’y aura plus de mal ni de destruction sur toute {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} montagne sainte. \q Tout le monde sur la terre connaîtra {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q La terre sera remplie de cette connaissance, comme les océans sont remplis d’eau.

sw.L: Hawatadhuru wala hawataharibu katika mlima wote wa utakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \q kwa maana dunia itajaa kumjua {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} \q kama maji yanavyoifunika bahari.
sw.B: Hakuna atakayedhuru wala kuharibu popote katika mlima {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mtakatifu, \q kwa maana dunia itajaa kumjua {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} \q kama bahari ilivyojaa maji.
sw.R: Hakutakuwa na madhara wala uharibifu popote katika mlima {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mtakatifu. \q Kila mtu duniani atamjua {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Dunia itajaa maarifa haya, kama bahari zilivyojaa maji.

decisions.choice: my holy mountain: Zion, the mountain of the LORD's house
decisions.reason: God speaks of the mountain where his temple stands (2:2-3; 27:13). The peace of verses 6-8 reaches all of it, and the next line widens it to the whole earth.

decisions.choice: they will not harm: no creature, animal or human
decisions.reason: The verbs have no named subject. They follow the animals of verses 6-8 and lead into the knowledge that fills the earth, so they cover any creature that might do harm.

decisions.choice: the earth full of the knowledge of Yahweh: knowing him, as waters cover the sea
decisions.reason: Habakkuk 2:14 uses nearly the same words, and Isaiah 65:25 repeats the first line. "Knowledge of Yahweh" means knowing him in trust and obedience (Hosea 4:1, 6), not only knowing facts about him. The sea is pictured as the sea bed, covered completely by its waters.

decisions.choice: as the sea is full of water
decisions.reason: Balanced says the comparison plainly: the earth will be as full of knowing the LORD as the sea is of water.

decisions.choice: Everyone on earth will know the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable states what a world full of the knowledge of the LORD means (m3).

source.text: וְהָיָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא שֹׁ֣רֶשׁ יִשַׁ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֹמֵד֙ לְנֵ֣ס עַמִּ֔ים אֵלָ֖יו גּוֹיִ֣ם יִדְרֹ֑שׁוּ וְהָיְתָ֥ה מְנֻחָת֖וֹ כָּבֽוֹד׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And it will be in that day [the] root of Jesse who [is] standing as [a] banner of [the] peoples, to him nations will seek, and will be his resting place glory.

en.L: And it will be in that day [that] the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner for the peoples, \q of him [the] nations will inquire, \q and his resting place will be glory.
en.B: On that day the root of Jesse will stand as a rallying flag for the peoples. \q Nations will turn to him for guidance, \q and the place where he settles will be filled with glory.
en.R: At that time a king from Jesse's family will stand like a flag raised high for all peoples to see. \q The nations will come to him to ask for his guidance. \q The place where he lives will be full of glory.

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel día [que] la raíz de Isaí, que estará de pie como bandera para los pueblos, \q a él buscarán [las] naciones, \q y su lugar de reposo será gloria.
es.B: Aquel día la raíz de Isaí se alzará como bandera para reunir a los pueblos. \q Las naciones acudirán a él en busca de guía, \q y el lugar donde él repose se llenará de gloria.
es.R: En ese tiempo un rey de la familia de Isaí se alzará como una bandera levantada en alto para que la vean todos los pueblos. \q Las naciones vendrán a él a pedirle que las guíe. \q El lugar donde viva estará lleno de gloria.

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce jour-là [que] la racine de Jessé, qui se tient comme un étendard pour les peuples, \q les nations le rechercheront, \q et son lieu de repos sera gloire.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, la racine de Jessé se dressera comme un étendard de ralliement pour les peuples. \q Les nations se tourneront vers lui pour le consulter, \q et le lieu où il s’établira sera rempli de gloire.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, un roi de la famille de Jessé se dressera comme un drapeau levé bien haut pour que tous les peuples le voient. \q Les nations viendront vers lui pour lui demander conseil. \q Le lieu où il habitera sera plein de gloire.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ile [kwamba] shina la Yese, atakayesimama kama bendera kwa mataifa, \q yeye mataifa watamtafuta, \q na mahali pake pa kupumzika patakuwa utukufu.
sw.B: Siku hiyo shina la Yese atasimama kama bendera ya kuyakusanya mataifa. \q Mataifa yatamwendea kutafuta mwongozo, \q na mahali atakapokaa patajaa utukufu.
sw.R: Wakati huo mfalme kutoka jamaa ya Yese atasimama kama bendera iliyoinuliwa juu ili watu wote waione. \q Mataifa yatakuja kwake kuomba mwongozo wake. \q Mahali anapoishi patajaa utukufu.

decisions.choice: the root of Jesse: the king who comes from Jesse's line
decisions.reason: Verse 1 spoke of a shoot from Jesse's roots; here the king himself is called the root, the one in whom Jesse's family lives on. Paul quotes this verse from the Septuagint in Romans 15:12, and Revelation 5:5 and 22:16 call Jesus "the Root of David".

decisions.choice: banner: a pole or flag raised as a signal to gather; seek: come to ask guidance
decisions.reason: A banner was set up on a height to call people together (5:26; 18:3). The verb "seek" is used of going to inquire of God or of a prophet (8:19; 2 Kings 1:2). Here the nations come to the king of Jesse's line for direction (compare 2:3).

decisions.choice: his resting place: the place where he dwells
decisions.reason: The word is used of the place where the LORD rests among his people, his house on Zion (Psalm 132:8, 14), and of the land as Israel's rest (Deuteronomy 12:9). It will be marked by glory.

decisions.choice: a king from Jesse's family
decisions.reason: Readable explains "root of Jesse" (m1). He is a king because verses 1-5 show him judging and ruling.

decisions.choice: will be filled with glory
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says his resting place will be "glory". Balanced says it will be filled with glory; Literal keeps the noun.

decisions.choice: la raíz de Isaí
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this verse in Romans 15:12; the key words "la raíz de Isaí" are kept so the reader can see the quotation, without copying its Greek-based wording.

decisions.choice: "shina la Yese"
decisions.reason: The terms note settles "shina la Yese" here, near Romans 15:12's "mzizi wa Yese", which quotes the verse from the Greek.

decisions.choice: "la racine de Jessé"
decisions.reason: Romans 15:12 quotes the verse, and the published French there says "la racine de Jessé".

source.text: וְהָיָ֣ה׀בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יוֹסִ֨יף אֲדֹנָ֤י׀שֵׁנִית֙ יָד֔וֹ לִקְנ֖וֹת אֶת־שְׁאָ֣ר עַמּ֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשָּׁאֵר֩ מֵאַשּׁ֨וּר וּמִמִּצְרַ֜יִם וּמִפַּתְר֣וֹס וּמִכּ֗וּשׁ וּמֵעֵילָ֤ם וּמִשִּׁנְעָר֙ וּמֵ֣חֲמָ֔ת וּמֵאִיֵּ֖י הַיָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be in that day, will add [the] Lord a second [time] his hand to acquire [the] remnant of his people that will remain from Assyria and from Egypt and from Pathros and from Cush and from Elam and from Shinar and from Hamath and from [the] coastlands of the sea.

en.L: And it will be in that day [that] the Lord will again [set] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand a second time \q to acquire the remnant of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people who remain, \q from Assyria and from Egypt and from Pathros and from Cush and from Elam and from Shinar and from Hamath \q and from the coastlands of the sea.
en.B: On that day the Lord will act again with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own hand, a second time, \q to win back the remnant of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people who are left: \q from Assyria and from Egypt, from Pathros and Cush, from Elam, Shinar, and Hamath, \q and from the coastlands of the sea.
en.R: At that time the Lord will use {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power a second time. \q He will win back those of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people who are left. \q They will come from Assyria and Egypt, from southern Egypt and Cush, from Elam, Babylonia, and Hamath, \q and from lands far away across the sea.

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel día [que] el Señor volverá a [poner] {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano por segunda vez \q para adquirir el remanente de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo que quede, \q de Asiria y de Egipto y de Patros y de Cus y de Elam y de Sinar y de Hamat \q y de las costas del mar.
es.B: Aquel día el Señor volverá a actuar con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia mano, por segunda vez, \q para recobrar el remanente de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo que haya quedado: \q de Asiria y de Egipto, de Patros y de Cus, de Elam, de Sinar y de Hamat, \q y de las costas lejanas del mar.
es.R: En ese tiempo el Señor usará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder por segunda vez. \q Recobrará a los de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo que hayan quedado. \q Vendrán de Asiria y de Egipto, del sur de Egipto y de Cus, de Elam, de Babilonia y de Hamat, \q y de las islas y costas lejanas.

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce jour-là que le Seigneur [mettra] encore une seconde fois {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main \q pour acquérir le reste de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple qui sera resté, \q de l’Assyrie et de l’Égypte, et de Pathros et de Koush, et d’Élam et de Shinéar, et de Hamath, \q et des îles de la mer.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, le Seigneur agira de nouveau de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} propre main, une seconde fois, \q pour racheter le reste de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple qui aura survécu : \q en Assyrie et en Égypte, à Pathros et en Koush, en Élam, à Shinéar et à Hamath, \q et dans les îles lointaines de la mer.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, le Seigneur se servira de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance une seconde fois. \q Il reprendra ceux de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple qui seront restés. \q Ils viendront d’Assyrie et d’Égypte, du sud de l’Égypte et de Koush, d’Élam, de Babylonie et de Hamath, \q et des pays lointains au-delà de la mer.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ile [kwamba] Bwana ataweka tena mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mara ya pili \q kuwakomboa mabaki ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} watakaobaki, \q kutoka Ashuru na kutoka Misri na kutoka Pathrosi na kutoka Kushi na kutoka Elamu na kutoka Shinari na kutoka Hamathi \q na kutoka visiwa vya bahari.
sw.B: Siku hiyo Bwana atatenda tena kwa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe, mara ya pili, \q kuwarudisha mabaki ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} walioachwa: \q kutoka Ashuru na kutoka Misri, kutoka Pathrosi na Kushi, kutoka Elamu, Shinari na Hamathi, \q na kutoka pwani za mbali za bahari.
sw.R: Wakati huo Bwana atatumia nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} mara ya pili. \q Atawarudisha watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} waliobaki. \q Watakuja kutoka Ashuru na Misri, kutoka kusini mwa Misri na Kushi, kutoka Elamu, Babeli na Hamathi, \q na kutoka nchi za mbali ng'ambo ya bahari.

decisions.choice: a second time ... to acquire: a new exodus
decisions.reason: The first time was the exodus from Egypt, named in verse 16. The verb "acquire" (buy, take as one's own) is the one used in the song of the sea for "the people you acquired" (Exodus 15:16).

decisions.choice: the remnant of his people that remains
decisions.reason: Isaiah has spoken of a remnant that will survive judgment and return (10:20-22; compare the name of his son Shear-jashub, "a remnant will return", 7:3).

decisions.choice: the places: from Egypt and Cush in the south to Assyria, Elam and Babylonia in the east
decisions.reason: Pathros is southern (Upper) Egypt (Jeremiah 44:1). Cush lay south of Egypt, along the upper Nile. Elam lay east of Babylonia, and Shinar is Babylonia (Genesis 10:10; 11:2). Hamath was a city in Syria. The coastlands of the sea are the lands along the Mediterranean to the west. Together they name the ends of the known world.

decisions.choice: southern Egypt; Babylonia; lands far away across the sea
decisions.reason: Readable gives the modern names for Pathros and Shinar and explains the coastlands (m3).

decisions.choice: act again with his own hand (B); use his power (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "he will add his hand a second time", leaving the verb understood. Literal supplies "set"; Balanced says he will act with his hand; Readable explains the hand as his power.

decisions.choice: las costas (L); las costas lejanas (B); las islas y costas lejanas (R)
decisions.reason: Iyyim is set as the terms note gives it from Psalms 72:10 and 97:1. Book-wide choice for chapters 1-20.

decisions.choice: *iyyim*: "visiwa" (L), "pwani za mbali" (B), "nchi za mbali ng'ambo ya bahari" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for the coastlands (Psalm 97:1; 72:10 R; terms note). Recorded once for this block.

decisions.choice: "les îles" (L); "les îles lointaines" (B); "les pays lointains" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note’s wording for *iyyim*, as Psalm 97:1 and 72:10, for the whole book.

decisions.choice: "Koush ... Shinéar"
decisions.reason: The published French forms (Psalm 7:1; Joshua 7:21); Readable says "Babylonie" for Shinar, as the English.

source.text: וְנָשָׂ֥א נֵס֙ לַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְאָסַ֖ף נִדְחֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּנְפֻצ֤וֹת יְהוּדָה֙ יְקַבֵּ֔ץ מֵאַרְבַּ֖ע כַּנְפ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he will raise [a] banner for [the] nations and gather [the] banished of Israel, and [the] scattered of Judah he will assemble from [the] four corners of the earth.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will raise a banner for the nations \q and will gather the banished of Israel, \q and the scattered of Judah {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will assemble \q from the four corners of the earth.
en.B: He will hoist a flag as a signal to the nations. \q Those driven out of Israel {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will gather in, \q and those of Judah who were scattered {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will bring together \q from the four corners of the earth.
en.R: He will raise a flag as a signal for the nations. \q He will gather the people of Israel who were forced to leave their land. \q He will bring together the people of Judah who were scattered in every direction over the earth.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} alzará una bandera para las naciones, \q y reunirá a los desterrados de Israel, \q y a los dispersos de Judá {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} juntará \q desde los cuatro extremos de la tierra.
es.B: Izará una bandera como señal para las naciones. \q Recogerá a los expulsados de Israel, \q y juntará a los dispersos de Judá \q desde los cuatro extremos de la tierra.
es.R: Levantará una bandera como señal para las naciones. \q Reunirá a la gente de Israel que fue obligada a dejar su tierra. \q Juntará a la gente de Judá que fue dispersada por toda la tierra.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lèvera un étendard pour les nations, \q et rassemblera les bannis d’Israël, \q et les dispersées de Juda, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les réunira \q des quatre coins de la terre.
fr.B: Il dressera un étendard comme signal pour les nations. \q Ceux d’Israël qui ont été chassés, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les rassemblera, \q et ceux de Juda qui ont été dispersés, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les réunira \q des quatre coins de la terre.
fr.R: Il lèvera un drapeau comme signal pour les nations. \q Il rassemblera les gens d’Israël qui ont été obligés de quitter leur pays. \q Il réunira les gens de Juda qui ont été dispersés dans toutes les directions sur la terre.

sw.L: Naye atainua bendera kwa mataifa \q na atawakusanya waliofukuzwa wa Israeli, \q na waliotawanyika wa Yuda atawakusanya \q kutoka pembe nne za dunia.
sw.B: Atainua bendera kuwa ishara kwa mataifa. \q Wale waliofukuzwa kutoka Israeli atawakusanya, \q na wale wa Yuda waliotawanyika atawaleta pamoja \q kutoka pembe nne za dunia.
sw.R: Atainua bendera kuwa ishara kwa mataifa. \q Atawakusanya watu wa Israeli waliolazimishwa kuondoka katika nchi yao. \q Atawaleta pamoja watu wa Yuda waliotawanyika kila upande wa dunia.

decisions.choice: he will raise a banner: the Lord's signal, now to bring his people home
decisions.reason: In 5:26 the LORD raised a banner to summon a distant nation against his people. Here the signal calls the nations to bring the exiles back (compare 49:22). In verse 10 the root of Jesse himself is the banner.

decisions.choice: the banished of Israel and the scattered of Judah: all the exiles, men and women
decisions.reason: The first word is masculine and the second feminine. Used in pairs like this, the two forms together take in everyone.

decisions.choice: the four corners of the earth: the farthest places in every direction
decisions.reason: The word is "wings", the edges of a garment, used of the ends of the earth (Ezekiel 7:2; Job 37:3; Revelation 7:1).

decisions.choice: scattered in every direction over the earth
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom (m3).

decisions.choice: "les bannis ... les dispersées"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew’s masculine then feminine forms, which together take in everyone (meaning decision m2).

source.text: וְסָ֨רָה֙ קִנְאַ֣ת אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְצֹרְרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה יִכָּרֵ֑תוּ אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ לֹֽא־יְקַנֵּ֣א אֶת־יְהוּדָ֔ה וִֽיהוּדָ֖ה לֹֽא־יָצֹ֥ר אֶת־אֶפְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And will turn aside [the] jealousy of Ephraim, and [the] adversaries of Judah will be cut off; Ephraim will not be jealous of Judah, and Judah will not be hostile to Ephraim.

en.L: And the jealousy of Ephraim will depart, \q and the adversaries of Judah will be cut off; \q Ephraim will not be jealous of Judah, \q and Judah will not be hostile to Ephraim.
en.B: Ephraim's envy will vanish, \q and Judah's adversaries will be cut off. \q Ephraim will no longer envy Judah, \q and Judah will no longer treat Ephraim as an enemy.
en.R: Ephraim, the northern kingdom of Israel, will stop being jealous. \q Those who are hostile to Judah will be removed. \q Ephraim will not be jealous of Judah, \q and Judah will not treat Ephraim as an enemy.

es.L: Y se apartará la envidia de Efraín, \q y los adversarios de Judá serán cortados; \q Efraín no envidiará a Judá, \q y Judá no hostigará a Efraín.
es.B: La envidia de Efraín desaparecerá, \q y los adversarios de Judá serán eliminados. \q Efraín ya no envidiará a Judá, \q y Judá ya no tratará a Efraín como enemigo.
es.R: Efraín, el reino de Israel en el norte, dejará de tener celos. \q Los que son hostiles a Judá serán quitados de en medio. \q Efraín no tendrá celos de Judá, \q y Judá no tratará a Efraín como enemigo.

fr.L: Et la jalousie d’Éphraïm disparaîtra, \q et les adversaires de Juda seront retranchés ; \q Éphraïm ne jalousera plus Juda, \q et Juda ne sera plus hostile à Éphraïm.
fr.B: L’envie d’Éphraïm s’évanouira, \q et les adversaires de Juda seront retranchés. \q Éphraïm n’enviera plus Juda, \q et Juda ne traitera plus Éphraïm en ennemi.
fr.R: Éphraïm, le royaume du nord, Israël, cessera d’être jaloux. \q Ceux qui sont hostiles à Juda seront supprimés. \q Éphraïm ne sera plus jaloux de Juda, \q et Juda ne traitera plus Éphraïm en ennemi.

sw.L: Na wivu wa Efraimu utaondoka, \q na adui za Yuda watakatiliwa mbali; \q Efraimu hatamwonea wivu Yuda, \q wala Yuda hatamhasimu Efraimu.
sw.B: Wivu wa Efraimu utatoweka, \q na adui za Yuda watakatiliwa mbali. \q Efraimu hatamwonea tena wivu Yuda, \q wala Yuda hatamtendea tena Efraimu kama adui.
sw.R: Efraimu, ufalme wa kaskazini wa Israeli, ataacha kuwa na wivu. \q Wale wanaoichukia Yuda wataondolewa. \q Efraimu hatamwonea Yuda wivu, \q wala Yuda hatamtendea Efraimu kama adui.

decisions.choice: Ephraim: the northern kingdom of Israel
decisions.reason: Ephraim was the largest northern tribe, and its name stands for the kingdom that split from Judah after Solomon (1 Kings 12). In Isaiah's day Ephraim had joined Aram to attack Judah (7:1-9). The reunited people will live at peace.

decisions.choice: the adversaries of Judah: those hostile to Judah
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean Judah's enemies, or those within Judah who are hostile, since the last line speaks of Judah's own hostility toward Ephraim. The phrase is kept as open as the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: jealous ... hostile: the old rivalry ended on both sides
decisions.reason: The last two lines repeat the nouns of the first two as verbs, in reverse order, to say that the hostility will end from both sides.

decisions.choice: Ephraim, the northern kingdom of Israel
decisions.reason: Readable says what Ephraim stands for (m1).

source.text: וְעָפ֨וּ בְכָתֵ֤ף פְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ יָ֔מָּה יַחְדָּ֖ו יָבֹ֣זּוּ אֶת־בְּנֵי־קֶ֑דֶם אֱד֤וֹם וּמוֹאָב֙ מִשְׁל֣וֹחיָדָ֔ם וּבְנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן מִשְׁמַעְתָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will fly on [the] shoulder of [the] Philistines westward; together they will plunder [the] sons of [the] east; Edom and Moab [will be the] reach of their hand, and [the] sons of Ammon [will be] their subjects.

en.L: And they will swoop on the shoulder of [the] Philistines to the west; \q together they will plunder the sons of the east; \q Edom and Moab [will be] the reach of their hand, \q and the sons of Ammon [will be] their subjects.
en.B: They will swoop down on the slopes of Philistia to the west; \q together they will plunder the peoples of the east. \q Edom and Moab will be within their grasp, \q and the Ammonites will obey them.
en.R: Israel and Judah will attack the Philistines in the west like birds swooping down. \q Together they will take the wealth of the peoples in the east. \q They will take control of Edom and Moab, \q and the Ammonites will obey them.

es.L: Y volarán sobre el hombro de [los] filisteos al occidente; \q juntos saquearán a los hijos del oriente; \q Edom y Moab [serán] el alcance de su mano, \q y los hijos de Amón [serán] sus súbditos.
es.B: Se lanzarán sobre las laderas de Filistea al occidente; \q juntos saquearán a los pueblos del oriente. \q Edom y Moab estarán a su alcance, \q y los amonitas les obedecerán.
es.R: Israel y Judá atacarán a los filisteos en el occidente como aves que se lanzan en picada. \q Juntos se llevarán las riquezas de los pueblos del oriente. \q Tomarán el control de Edom y Moab, \q y los amonitas les obedecerán.

fr.L: Et ils fondront sur l’épaule des Philistins à l’occident ; \q ensemble ils pilleront les fils de l’orient ; \q Édom et Moab [seront] la prise de leur main, \q et les fils d’Ammon [seront] leurs sujets.
fr.B: Ils fondront sur les pentes de la Philistie à l’ouest ; \q ensemble ils pilleront les peuples de l’est. \q Édom et Moab seront à leur portée, \q et les Ammonites leur obéiront.
fr.R: Israël et Juda attaqueront les Philistins à l’ouest, comme des oiseaux qui fondent sur leur proie. \q Ensemble, ils prendront les richesses des peuples de l’est. \q Ils domineront Édom et Moab, \q et les Ammonites leur obéiront.

sw.L: Nao watarukia bega la Wafilisti upande wa magharibi; \q pamoja watawateka nyara wana wa mashariki; \q Edomu na Moabu [watakuwa] chini ya mkono wao, \q na wana wa Amoni [watakuwa] watiifu kwao.
sw.B: Watashuka kwa kasi juu ya miteremko ya Ufilisti upande wa magharibi; \q pamoja watawateka nyara watu wa mashariki. \q Edomu na Moabu watakuwa mkononi mwao, \q na Waamoni watawatii.
sw.R: Israeli na Yuda watawashambulia Wafilisti upande wa magharibi kama ndege wanaoshuka kwa kasi. \q Pamoja watachukua mali za watu wa mashariki. \q Watatawala Edomu na Moabu, \q na Waamoni watawatii.

decisions.choice: fly on the shoulder: swoop like birds of prey on the slopes
decisions.reason: The verb pictures birds diving on prey. "Shoulder" is used of a slope or ridge of land (Joshua 15:8, 10), here the hills that slope down to the Philistine plain in the west.

decisions.choice: Philistia, Edom, Moab and Ammon: the neighbors David once ruled
decisions.reason: These were the peoples David defeated (2 Samuel 8:1-14). The reunited Israel and Judah will again hold the lands of David's kingdom. "The sons of the east" are the desert peoples east of the Jordan (Judges 6:3).

decisions.choice: the reach of their hand ... their subjects: under their power
decisions.reason: What one's hand reaches out to is what one takes hold of. The last word means "obedience", those who obey.

decisions.choice: Israel and Judah ... like birds swooping down
decisions.reason: Readable names the subject from verse 13 and explains the picture of flying (m1).

source.text: וְהֶחֱרִ֣ים יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֚ת לְשׁ֣וֹן יָם־מִצְרַ֔יִם וְהֵנִ֥יף יָד֛וֹ עַל־הַנָּהָ֖ר בַּעְיָ֣ם רוּח֑וֹ וְהִכָּ֨הוּ֙ לְשִׁבְעָ֣ה נְחָלִ֔ים וְהִדְרִ֖יךְ בַּנְּעָלִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And will devote to destruction Yahweh [the] tongue of [the] sea of Egypt, and he will wave his hand over the River with [the] scorching of his wind, and he will strike it into seven streams, and he will make [them] walk in sandals.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will devote to destruction the tongue of the sea of Egypt, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will wave {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand over the River with the scorching heat of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wind, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will strike it into seven streams, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will make [them] walk [across] in sandals.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will destroy the gulf of the Egyptian sea; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will sweep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand over the River with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} scorching wind \q and break it into seven streams, \q so that people can cross in their sandals.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will destroy the arm of the sea that reaches into Egypt. \q He will wave {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand over the Euphrates River and send a hot wind. \q He will break the river into seven small streams, \q so that people can walk across in their sandals.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} destruirá por completo la lengua del mar de Egipto, \q y agitará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano sobre el Río con el ardor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} viento, \q y lo herirá [dividiéndolo] en siete arroyos, \q y hará [que lo crucen] en sandalias.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} destruirá el golfo del mar de Egipto; \q pasará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano sobre el Río con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} viento abrasador \q y lo partirá en siete arroyos, \q para que la gente pueda cruzarlo en sandalias.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} destruirá el brazo de mar que entra en Egipto. \q Agitará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano sobre el río Éufrates y enviará un viento caliente. \q Partirá el río en siete arroyos pequeños, \q para que la gente pueda cruzarlo caminando en sandalias.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vouera à la destruction la langue de la mer d’Égypte, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} agitera {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main sur le Fleuve dans l’ardeur de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} vent, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le frappera en sept ruisseaux, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fera marcher [à travers] en sandales.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} détruira le golfe de la mer d’Égypte ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lèvera la main sur le Fleuve avec {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} vent brûlant \q et le brisera en sept ruisseaux, \q pour qu’on puisse le traverser en sandales.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} détruira le bras de mer qui entre en Égypte. \q Il agitera la main au-dessus de l’Euphrate et enverra un vent brûlant. \q Il séparera le fleuve en sept petits ruisseaux, \q pour qu’on puisse les traverser à pied, en sandales.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataiangamiza kabisa ghuba ya bahari ya Misri, \q naye atatikisa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} juu ya Mto kwa joto kali la upepo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q naye ataupiga uwe vijito saba, \q naye atawavusha [watu] wakiwa na viatu.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataiangamiza ghuba ya bahari ya Misri; \q atapunga mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} juu ya mto Frati kwa upepo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} unaounguza \q na kuugawa kuwa vijito saba, \q hata watu wataweza kuvuka wakiwa wamevaa viatu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataiangamiza sehemu ya bahari inayoingia Misri. \q Atapunga mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} juu ya mto Frati na kutuma upepo wa joto. \q Atauvunja mto huo kuwa vijito saba vidogo, \q ili watu waweze kuvuka wakiwa wamevaa viatu.

decisions.choice: devote to destruction: the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb means to give something over to destruction. A verb with almost the same letters means "dry up" (as in 50:2), and the Septuagint has "make desolate". The Hebrew reading is kept; either way the sea will no longer stand in the way of God's people.

decisions.choice: the tongue of the sea of Egypt ... the River: a gulf of the Red Sea, and the Euphrates
decisions.reason: The "tongue" of a sea is a bay or gulf (Joshua 15:2, 5). As God split the sea at the exodus with a strong wind (Exodus 14:21-22), he will open a way through the waters on both sides, Egypt and Assyria. "The River" is the Euphrates (7:20; 8:7).

decisions.choice: scorching heat: the burning force of his wind
decisions.reason: This word appears only here. It is usually taken to mean scorching heat, as of the hot east wind of Exodus 14:21; some take it to mean force or might.

decisions.choice: the Euphrates River; walk across in their sandals
decisions.reason: Readable names the River (m2). Walking across in sandals means crossing on dry ground.

decisions.choice: "ghuba" for the "tongue" of the sea
decisions.reason: "Ulimi wa bahari" is not used for a gulf in Swahili, so even Literal says "ghuba" (m2).

source.text: וְהָיְתָ֣ה מְסִלָּ֔ה לִשְׁאָ֣ר עַמּ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשָּׁאֵ֖ר מֵֽאַשּׁ֑וּר כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר הָֽיְתָה֙ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּי֥וֹם עֲלֹת֖וֹ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And there will be [a] highway for [the] remnant of his people that will remain from Assyria, just as there was for Israel on [the] day of its going up from [the] land of Egypt.

en.L: And there will be a highway \q for the remnant of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people who remain from Assyria, \q just as there was for Israel \q on the day it came up from the land of Egypt.
en.B: A highway will lead out of Assyria for the remnant of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people who are left there, \q as one did for Israel \q on the day they came up out of the land of Egypt.
en.R: There will be a road for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people who are left in Assyria to come home on. \q It will be like the way {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made for Israel when they came out of Egypt.

es.L: Y habrá un camino \q para el remanente de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo que quede de Asiria, \q así como lo hubo para Israel \q el día en que subió de la tierra de Egipto.
es.B: Habrá una calzada desde Asiria para el remanente de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo que haya quedado allí, \q como la hubo para Israel \q el día en que subieron de la tierra de Egipto.
es.R: Habrá un camino para que la gente de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo que haya quedado en Asiria pueda volver a casa. \q Será como el camino que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} abrió para Israel cuando salieron de Egipto.

fr.L: Et il y aura une route \q pour le reste de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple qui sera resté en Assyrie, \q comme il y en eut une pour Israël \q le jour où il monta du pays d’Égypte.
fr.B: Une route sortira d’Assyrie pour le reste de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple qui y sera resté, \q comme il y en eut une pour Israël \q le jour où il monta du pays d’Égypte.
fr.R: Il y aura une route pour que ceux de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple qui sont restés en Assyrie puissent rentrer chez eux. \q Ce sera comme le chemin qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a ouvert pour Israël quand il est sorti d’Égypte.

sw.L: Na kutakuwa na njia kuu \q kwa ajili ya mabaki ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} watakaobaki kutoka Ashuru, \q kama vile ilivyokuwa kwa Israeli \q katika siku alipopanda kutoka nchi ya Misri.
sw.B: Njia kuu itatoka Ashuru kwa ajili ya mabaki ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} walioachwa huko, \q kama ilivyokuwa kwa Israeli \q siku walipopanda kutoka nchi ya Misri.
sw.R: Kutakuwa na barabara ambayo watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} waliobaki Ashuru watapitia kurudi nyumbani. \q Itakuwa kama njia aliyowafanyia Israeli walipotoka Misri.

decisions.choice: highway: a raised, prepared road
decisions.reason: The word is a road built up and cleared for travel (19:23; 40:3; 62:10). Nothing will stand in the way of the exiles coming home.

decisions.choice: as there was for Israel when it came up from Egypt: the first exodus
decisions.reason: The return from Assyria will be a second exodus (verse 11). Hosea 2:17 likewise speaks of "the day she came up out of the land of Egypt".

decisions.choice: the way he made for Israel
decisions.reason: Readable says that it was God who made a way for Israel out of Egypt, as Exodus 14 tells.
